title: Beginning, Middle and Ending Sounds
introduction: Practise beginning, middle and ending sounds with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: Words are made of sounds. Listen for the first, middle and last sounds in short words.
rules: Change one sound to make a new word: cat, cap, map.

examples.question: Middle letter in cat?
steps: Change one sound to make a new word: cat, cap, map.
